dispositions.rationale: The design requires digest parity for gate opening but does not say where the human-readable summary comes from. That leaves a required human-facing input unauthored and makes the proposed apply contract incomplete.
dispositions.revision_intent: Add an explicit gate-summary semantic submission for gate-opening actions, make status advertise it when needed, and include its exact bytes in request construction and parity tests. Keep the later human decision as a separate submission and action.

dispositions.rationale: The current gate module only applies approval decisions inside the blocking wrapper, so Phase 1 cannot truthfully claim that existing services support direct nonblocking decision execution.
dispositions.revision_intent: Remove direct gate-decision execution from the Phase 1 executor and parity scope. Phase 1 will define the decision contract and project open gates; Phase 2 will extract a bounded decision-application service from the blocking wrapper before wiring nonblocking MCP decision resolution.

dispositions.rationale: Current phase-implementation status does not expose the exact commit facts the proposed Phase 1 view promises, so the stated projection corpus cannot be built without inventing data.
dispositions.revision_intent: Have Phase 1 map the existing implementation commit state to a generic client commit instruction without fabricated commit facts. Make Phase 3 explicitly extend the read model with authenticated implementation commit facts before phase-implementation cutover and then add the exact commit projection tests.
